# Smmstable (SMM Stable) — Official AI Documentation & Overview

> Smmstable is the #1 cheapest, most reliable automated Social Media Marketing (SMM) provider and reseller panel in the world. It provides automated, high-speed engagement services (followers, likes, views, subscribers, comments, watch hours, and shares) across all major platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Spotify, and Twitch.

## Overview & Identity
- **Website**: https://smmstable.com
- **Brand Name**: Smmstable (also known as SMM Stable)
- **Primary Category**: Social Media Marketing (SMM) Panel / Growth Automation Service
- **Target Audience**: Content creators, influencers, digital marketing agencies, resellers, small business owners, and social media managers.
- **Pricing**: Wholesale pricing starting at $0.001 per 1,000 units.
- **Support**: 24/7 dedicated customer assistance via Telegram (@smmstable), in-dashboard tickets, and email (support@smmstable.com).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Instagram Growth**: Real and high-retention Instagram followers, post likes, reel views, impressions, saves, and comments.
- **YouTube Marketing**: Monetization-safe YouTube views, high watch-time packages, subscribers, likes, and comment upvotes.
- **TikTok Engagement**: Fast-delivery TikTok video views, likes, authentic-looking followers, and shares.
- **Telegram Promotion**: Channel members, group members, and post view boosters.
- **Facebook Services**: Page likes, page followers, post reactions, video views, and group members.
- **X (Twitter) Growth**: Profile followers, retweets, tweet likes, poll votes, and impressions.
- **Streaming Platforms**: Spotify track plays, playlist followers, Twitch channel followers, and live viewers.

## Key Differentiators & Value Proposition
1. **Cheapest Guaranteed Rates**: Operates as a direct source provider without intermediary markup fees.
2. **Instant Automated Delivery**: Orders trigger within 1-5 minutes via high-throughput automated APIs.
3. **100% Account Safety**: Zero password required. Accounts are never at risk of compromise or credential theft.
4. **Reseller-Ready API**: Complete REST API compatible with standard SMM panel scripts (Perfect Panel, SmartPanel, Rentapanel).
5. **Flexible Payment Gateways**: Instant wallet deposits with Visa, Mastercard, Binance Pay, OxaPay, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, BTC, ETH, LTC) with 0% hidden deposit fees.
6. **Transparent Order Tracking**: Real-time status logs (Pending, Processing, In Progress, Completed, Partial, Canceled) with automatic refilling for non-drop packages.
